mechanism: Both are irreversible monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) that inhibit the same enzyme, causing accumulation of monoamines and severe hypertensive crisis, serotonin syndrome, and other adverse effects.
action: Absolute contraindication - do not combine these agents; ensure adequate washout period (at least 14 days between discontinuation of one and initiation of the other) and monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms.
